textline_cells.text: Some states may reflect lower than expected numbers for handgun checks based on varying state laws pertaining to handgun permits Since the permit check is done in place of the NICS check in most of the affected states, the low handgun statistics are often balanced out by a higher number of handgun permit checks

textline_cells.text: These statistics represent the number of firearm background checks initiated through the NICS They do not represent the number of firearms sold Based on varying state laws and purchase scenarios, a one-to-one correlation cannot be made between a firearm background check and a firearm sale
